note: Provenance and licence record for every out-of-domain negative source document. Written by training/fetch_negatives.py; consumed by training/build_negatives.py. Every document was disjoint from benchmark/carriers/ when it was fetched, asserted here at fetch time. That is a claim about the benchmark of the day and nothing more: on 2026-08-26 the benchmark grew from 154 carriers to 321 and drew 22 of the new ones from pages already in this manifest, which no fetch-time assertion could have foreseen. Disjointness is therefore re-established at build time by screen 2a in build_negatives.py and verified by check_contamination.py, both against the benchmark as it stands then. Growing the benchmark invalidates this claim until check_contamination.py is re-run.
